intro:
Most public universities in Germany charge no tuition fee — you fund living costs through a blocked account. For engineering and applied sciences it is the best value destination in Europe.

Germany is a popular study destination for international students, particularly for those interested in STEM, Engineering, Technology and research-based programs. Many public universities in Germany offer high-quality education with low or no tuition fees for many programs, making Germany an attractive option for students looking for affordable higher education in Europe.
why: No or very low tuition at public universities
visa: German National Student Visa — admission letter, blocked account of roughly €11,900, health insurance and APS certificate for Indian students.
intakes: Winter (October) is the major intake, Summer (April) is smaller. Start 10–12 months ahead — APS and blocked account add lead time.

req.label: Documents
req.value: APS, Marksheets, Resume, SOP, 2 LORs, transcripts, passport, Blocked account proof

steps.title: Get APS certificate
steps.text: Apply to the APS India office — takes about 4 weeks

steps.title: Secure admission
steps.text: Apply via uni-assist or directly to the university

steps.title: Open blocked account
steps.text: Deposit approximately €11,904 with an approved provider

steps.title: Book visa appointment
steps.text: Slots fill fast — book as soon as admission arrives

steps.title: Visa interview
steps.text: Attend with APS, admission letter, blocked account and insurance

work: You can work 120 full days or 240 half days a year. After graduating you get an 18-month job-seeker residence permit, and an EU Blue Card follows once you have a qualifying salary offer.
